findings.title: Acceptance REQ-014 R19 (a recorded run) rests only on the session record, which a review may not read; it cannot be verified independently from the evidence a review can use.
findings.evidence: Runner manifest entry 5: not run, not a command.
findings.consequence: The acceptance condition stays unverifiable round after round unless the run output is routed through the runner path.

notes: Round 8 shadow review, dispatched by the Session Manager after the runner finished, with the phase entry, the full and cycle-9 diffs and the runner manifest path. No checkout. Raw reply kept at _working/session-manager/review-replies/phase-idg-12-b8d2c6f3-review-judge.md.
